title: The homotopy type of the moment-angle complex associated to the complex of injective words
summary: Topological methods have emerged as valuable tools for analyzing the structural properties of directed graphs, particularly connectome data in computational neuroscience. This paper investigates the construction of topological spaces from combinatorial data of directed graphs using the polyhedral product functor, with particular emphasis on understanding their homotopy type, which is also of independent interest in topology and combinatorics.
